name: NudgeVia Ai Abandonned Cart Recovery for WooCommerce
author: sproutient

sections.description:
Turn missed sales into revenue with smart, personalized follow-ups.
Our AI-powered cart abandonment recovery system automatically detects when a customer leaves without completing their purchase — then generates and sends personalized emails tailored to their cart contents, behavior, and your brand’s voice. No templates to write, no workflows to build. Just plug it in and let the system re-engage your shoppers at the right time, with the right message — increasing conversions while you sleep.

Features:
* Send cart recovery emails.

External services

This plugin connects to nudgevia.ai API, it’s needed to send recovery/review request emails.

This service is provided by “NudgeVia.ai”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Nudgevia plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Dashboard > Nudgevia to configure your Nudgevia API/Site key.
sections.faq:
How do I connect my Nudgevia account?

Go to Dashboard > Nudgevia and click on settings tab and enter your Nudgevia API/Site key. This will allow the plugin to interact with your Nudgevia account.

Do I need a NudgeVia.ai account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active NudgeVia.ai account with API access.
